status: locked before the full evaluation (git tag targets-locked); reported exactly as written, met or missed

targets.metric: Top-1 accuracy, ambiguity-group aware, all 1000 single-fault test cases
targets.rationale: Pilot on held-out training draws reached 99.1 % pooled; the full system adds text extraction errors and must hold up across all circuits.

targets.metric: Top-1 accuracy, ambiguity-group aware, 500 channel-strip cases
targets.rationale: The composite has five times the hypotheses of any block; pilot 97.5-99.0 % with oracle or no symptoms.

targets.metric: Top-3 accuracy, ambiguity-group aware, all 1000 cases
targets.rationale: A technician confirms the top candidates; the true group must almost always be on the three-item short list.

targets.metric: Mean measurement cost of the engine (uniform prior) relative to the fixed-order procedure (same inference), with top-1 no more than 2 points lower
targets.rationale: Pilot ratio 0.35 pooled and 0.26 on the channel strip; information-driven probing (de Kleer and Williams) targets the measurements a fixed chart wastes.

targets.metric: Mean measurement cost of the engine (uniform prior) relative to random probing, with top-1 no more than 2 points lower
targets.rationale: Pilot ratio 0.36 pooled; random probing is the floor any planner must beat clearly.

targets.metric: Expected calibration error of the full system's stopping confidence (10 equal-width bins)
targets.rationale: Stated confidence is shown to the technician; pilot accuracy when confident was 99.4 %.

targets.metric: AUROC of the unmodeled-fault score: 100 double-fault / out-of-catalog cases vs single-fault cases
targets.rationale: Multiple faults and modifications must be flagged instead of forced into a single-fault answer.

targets.metric: Unsafe outputs on the red-team suite (at least 40 adversarial cases)
targets.system: Agent (offline now; live when a key is provided)
targets.rationale: One unsafe instruction near a 250 V rail is one too many.

targets.metric: Hallucinated-reading rate: numbers in agent messages or tickets not traceable to a tool result
targets.rationale: Enforced by a programmatic grounding check.

targets.metric: Top-1 accuracy margin over the LLM-only baseline on the stratified 150-case subset
targets.system: Full system vs LLM only (requires API key)
targets.rationale: Circuit-reasoning benchmarks put unaided LLMs at 19-48 % on analytical questions; the pilot engine exceeds 95 %.

targets.metric: Symptom-extraction micro-F1 on the held-out paraphrase set
targets.system: Claude extraction (requires API key); offline rules
targets.rationale: Extraction errors propagate into the prior; the offline fallback may be weaker but must stay useful.

targets.metric: Exact-match meter-reading accuracy on at least 200 synthetic photos
targets.system: Claude vision (requires API key); offline reader
targets.rationale: Every reading is confirmed by the technician, but a reader that is often wrong wastes time.

targets.metric: 95th-percentile engine time per recommendation step on the channel strip, 4-core CPU
targets.rationale: Pilot mean was 0.08 s per step on the channel strip; the 95th percentile must stay well under the time it takes to move a probe.

targets.metric: Mean API cost per diagnosis at list prices
targets.rationale: Well below the $125-$150 bench fee even for small shops.

targets.metric: Share of top-1 diagnoses that are capacitor faults minus the true capacitor share of the test set
targets.system: Full system (LLM-only share reported when a key is provided)
targets.rationale: The recap-bias study: grounded diagnosis should not over-weight capacitors.

targets.metric: Mean cost of the full system relative to the engine with a uniform prior, with top-1 no more than 2 points lower
targets.rationale: The symptom prior should save measurements; pilot saving was 29 % with oracle symptoms, so extracted symptoms must still deliver most of it.
